note_tweet.text:
Good dogs make me cry for all the dogs who need a home and Love. My dog saved my life by forcing me to go to hospital. A big dog she got on my lap, shoved her snout into my mouth and started whining and barking at me.
I had sepsis, DKA, and esophageal cancer. Survived everything and totally submit to the full medical evaluations she performs on me daily!
